basic_info.description: Perched atop Nob Hill near Grace Cathedral, this top-floor 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath condominium in The Courtyard on Nob Hill combines serene comfort with sweeping city views in one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods. Dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows frame the city skyline and flood the living area with natural light, while the generous open layout easily accommodates comfortable living. Inside, a wood-burning fireplace, in-unit laundry hookups, and abundant closet space add to the convenience and appeal of this spacious city retreat. This boutique 42-unit building features side-by-side garage parking, two elevators serving all floors, and a part-time on-site building coordinator. Residents enjoy a beautifully renovated library/meeting room, a lush garden with a gazebo and tranquil fountain, an expansive rooftop terrace with panoramic city and Golden Gate Bridge views, and a contemporary, welcoming lobby. Whether as a full-time residence or an elegant pied--terre, this home presents a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of San Francisco livingsteps from Union Square and the Theater District.
